runs.narr: Q2 OUT: the standing castle that protects only ordinary returns over the 2014 to 2024 cycle (6.8% a year pre-tax on tangible capital with every impairment added back, -8.0% on book capital 2015 to 2025); pre-tax margin 2015 to 2025 -10.9% against SLB 2.5%, Halliburton 0.6%, Baker Hughes -1.6%, the lowest of the field the 10-K names; drill-bit royalties lost at trial; $7.3B of goodwill written off from 2015. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: quarterly guidance missed and pre-announced, Adjusted EBITDA featured and the bonus measure. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: value $5.19 to $11.06 all-equity against $18.64, fair $3.92 all-equity ($4.24 equity-only), not armed. Framework gaps for the operator: which capital ordinary returns are judged on; the full cycle for a decade-long cycle; the interest-shield tax rate.
